name: Residencia Legal Permanente -- MERCOSUR

requirements.blocker_text: Available to nationals of MERCOSUR member and associated states: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, Suriname, and Guyana, with simplified documentation compared to the general permanent residency (electronically-issued documents do not require apostille; Brazilian documents are exempt from translation).

evidence_required.document: Criminal record certificate (past 5 years of residence, 6+ months each)

sources.title: Sitio oficial de la República Oriental del Uruguay -- Residencia Legal Permanente MERCOSUR: eligible nationalities, document simplifications, cost exemptions for Paraguay/Brazil

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Paraguayan and Brazilian nationals are exempt from the standard 557.30 UI fee entirely, per the source -- reproduced as a specific, concrete benefit rather than generalised. Does not require the income/means documentation that uy_permanent_residency_general demands, per the simplified-process framing in the source -- a materially easier route for MERCOSUR nationals specifically.
